1. 마태복음의 내용과 90%이상 일치\n - 마태복음의 내용과 90%:
1. Over 90% the same as the content of Matthew
 - Over 90% of it matches the content of Matthew.
 - Thought to be the earliest written of the four Gospels. Because its content is the shortest.
 - Mark was written by Mark, who ministered to Greeks, so the genealogy is left out. They had no interest in Jewish genealogies.
마가의 다락방 – 사실은 2층: Mark's upper room – actually a second floor
3. 마가복음의 내용\n 1) 세례요한의 사역과 그리스도의 준비\n 2):
3. The content of Mark
 1) John the Baptist's ministry and the preparation of Christ
 2) Jesus calls the disciples
 3) Parables about the kingdom of heaven
 - When Jesus taught, many things in God's kingdom don't exist on this earth, so he couldn't say it directly, and he says "The kingdom of heaven is like ~~". He always spoke in parables.
 4) Jesus heals the sick and the demon-possessed
 5) Seven loaves and two fish.  4,000 people
 6) Peter's confession of faith "Thou art the Christ, the Son of the living God"
 7) The glory shown on the Mount of Transfiguration
 8) Events on the way up to Jerusalem
 - Meeting Bartimaeus
 9) Predictions of his suffering
 - On the way up to Jerusalem he stresses it again and again. Because if he hadn't said these things and then it happened, people could misunderstand it as if Jesus had met with an unexpected accident.
10) 예루살렘 성에 들어가심\n 11) 성전 숙청\n 12) 마지막 한:
10) Entering the city of Jerusalem
 11) Cleansing the temple
 12) Teachings of the last week
 13) The first and great commandment, 'love God, love your neighbor'
 14) Mark's eschatology
 15) Mary pouring expensive perfume in the house of Simon the leper in Bethany
 - In the other Gospels the place isn't clearly given, but here the place is clearly stated.
 16) The Last Supper
  17) Christ's suffering, resurrection and ascension
